question: Whether the fresh source-addressed Alpha underwriting record changes the prior Resolver adjudication that improved lithium/portfolio profitability can coexist with Kemerton Train 1 remaining idled for insufficient conversion economics.
whyItMatters: ALB remains packet_ready with unresolved_material_contradiction after new Alpha evidence; Resolver must determine whether the changed input creates a genuine factual conflict without taking over Alpha underwriting.
lawfulFallbacks: Preserve asset-specific conversion-economics risk as material underwriting evidence
Await newer primary evidence if Kemerton restart economics materially change
successCondition: Determine whether the fresh Alpha record creates a mutually exclusive claim or instead independently confirms the prior scope distinction.
resolution: The changed Alpha input independently confirms rather than contradicts the prior adjudication. Alpha source-addresses Q2 Energy Storage/company profitability improvement and separately source-addresses Kemerton idling, explicitly treating Kemerton as evidence that resource scale does not ensure durable conversion economics. Portfolio/segment recovery and asset-specific downstream weakness therefore coexist at different economic scopes. Preserve lithium-price sensitivity, Kemerton conversion-cost disadvantage, restart uncertainty and physical-ramp risk as material non-gating risks; do not infer that portfolio recovery proves Kemerton economics.
falsifiers: New primary evidence showing Kemerton Train 1 was economically viable on the same assumptions and period yet remained idled for a mutually exclusive stated reason
Evidence showing the cited Q2 profitability improvement was specifically Kemerton-level rather than Energy Storage/portfolio-level
repeatedBlocker: ALB contradiction was re-emitted after prior Resolver resolution because the input signature changed with a fresh Alpha score record.
failedStrategy: A first-pass scope adjudication resolved the contradiction before Alpha completed the fresh source-addressed score record, but routing later re-emitted the item on changed input.
changedStrategy: Instead of repeating open-ended research, tested only the new Alpha record against the prior falsifiers and scope boundary; the new evidence corroborates the existing resolution.
